title: Founder
description: One founder of the venture (people/founders/<id>.json): role, the functions they own, when they joined, and where their founder agreement is. One file per founder, so each founder's record changes on its own.

hats.description: The functions this founder owns, in the flat layout. In the structured layout (EE-086) they are read from venture.json

profile.description: Who the founder is, as a mentor learns it (Torian's playbook). Built from a template of attributes in purpose/frameworks/founder-profile/attributes.json; any attribute from that library can be added. Each attribute is a list of entries, prose in the founder's words with an optional type

template.description: The template it started from; default if absent

summary.description: The mentor's prose portrait, for reasoning models

type.description: One of the attribute's types in purpose/frameworks/founder-profile/attributes.json

function.description: For a strength or weakness of type venture-function: the venture function it is about

confirmed.description: The founder said the profile reads true
